title: Crash while trying to create D3D12 device when neither D3D12 nor Vulkan are supported
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.dev5.official [64b09905c]

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev5 - macOS Sequoia (15.1.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads)

### Issue description

When `rendering/rendering_device/fallback_to_d3d12` is enabled, trying to run a windows build of a Forward+ project on a system where neither D3D12, Vulkan or Metal are supported by Godot (ARM Parallels VM in this case) results in a crash instead of OpenGL fallback:

```bash
Godot Engine v4.5.dev5.official.64b09905c - https://godotengine.org
WARNING: Your video card drivers seem not to support Vulkan, switching to Direct3D 12.
     at: DisplayServerWindows (platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:7007)
ERROR: D3D12CreateDevice failed with error 0x887a0004.
   at: (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:5710)
ERROR: Condition "err != OK" is true. Returning: ERR_CANT_CREATE
   at: initialize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:6071)
ERROR: Failed to initialize driver for device.
   at: (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6693)

================================================================
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.dev5.official (64b09905c7b2877f8aef99d8b63e73e5d31acfb9)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
[...]
[22] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
================================================================
```

If `rendering/rendering_device/fallback_to_d3d12` is disabled engine falls back to OpenGL and runs the game with no crash:

```
WARNING: Your video card drivers seem not to support Direct3D 12 or Vulkan, switching to OpenGL 3.
     at: DisplayServerWindows (platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:7020)
OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 89.3 - Compatibility - Using Device: Parallels and Apple - Parallels using Apple M1 Max (Compat)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Run a Forward+ project in Parallels VM on an ARM mac

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
